title: Actual 1D/4H historical backfill gestures, pending state, native-Pionex source continuity
changes: Mouse wheel at the current 90/270 display cap continues browsing backwards instead of silently doing nothing.
User drags near the oldest loaded candle start an idempotent Pionex history prefetch before releasing the pointer.
History state is shown directly in each chart (loaded bars, loading, exhausted or error) and success/failure is announced.
Use same Pionex REST direct source if Worker endpoint is not yet available (only if browser CORS permits).
If the initial chart provider differs from native Pionex at the seam, verify official recent Pionex candles before changing the OHLC baseline; never silently mix unrelated exchange bars.
Keep initial history 95 1D / 130 4H, no startup backfill and no fake K lines.
validationNote: Local browser integration uses synthetic Pionex API responses; production Worker deployment cannot be established from static files.
